title: Kenneth K NDE 9569
content: My platoon was coming back from one of our small outposts. A car sped past us on the road. I didn’t pay any attention to the car, but others in my platoon did. I heard the radio saying to be ready, because a guy just dropped off two women and then took off in a different direction. We knew something was going to happen since these were common tactics of prior ambush attacks. On our way to another outpost, nothing happened. So we kept pushing forward. The lead truck ran over an improvised explosive device (IED), causing it to explode 3 to 5 seconds later. I was in the second truck that took the force of the explosion. I remember looking down on my body and thinking, 'Man, they got me! This is where my story ends.' I was looking at all of the destruction. I saw wheels with tires still attached and fuel tanks flying hundreds of feet outward. I didn’t see a light. I just remember looking down and saying, 'No, this isn’t how it’s going to end for me. All of the sudden, I was lying down on my pedestal. I am 100% disabled, and I still have nightmares. I wake up in tears every day and have to escape into pills for a few more hours of sleep to wake up feeling somewhat normal Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: August 20, 2011 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Criminal attack. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. Involved in an IED explosion How do you consider the content of your experience? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? The end Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Christian- Protestant Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Large changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes. Have grown very regretful of how I was raised by my father After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Normal Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Everything was blown to pieces and they found the remains of the home made explosive What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. I know it. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Nothing, this was great

context.nde_cause_other_detail: IED explosion/ambush while in a platoon convoy.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Out-of-body observation of his body and destruction, then he was suddenly back lying down on his pedestal.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience described as entirely distressing with anger; no tunnel, light, beings, or otherworldly realm. States he is now 100% disabled with nightmares and uses pills to sleep.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Man, they got me! This is where my story ends.” / “No, this isn’t how it’s going to end for me.”
